label: The first satisfiable depth
subgoals: Run breadth-first search from the initial states
Find the distance of the nearest bad state
Report that distance as the first satisfiable BMC depth

label: Counters and modular arithmetic
subgoals: Write the register value after k cycles modulo 2^n
Solve s + ck = t modulo 2^n for the smallest k
Use the modular inverse of the odd step to find k

label: Stepping the bound
subgoals: Locate the first checked depth at or beyond the true depth
Count the checks from depth 0 up to it
Compute the count as the ceiling of D over d, plus 1
